explanation: Total momentum is exactly conserved through step 1 (momentum_x ~1e-16, momentum_y 44.21291925 equal to initial 44.21291925) with 7 substeps, but at step 2 with 8 substeps momentum_x becomes -0.01004 and momentum_y drops to 44.04149, a change of 0.1717 exceeding allowed 0.1115. The jump coincides with increased acceleration/close approach of bodies 1-2 (distance 1.478 at step 2) triggering a different substep count. Reducing only dt removes the violation, indicating the adaptive leapfrog substepping breaks pairwise force symmetry / momentum conservation when substep count changes under strong acceleration.
